meta.title: Dimension-Based Routing: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Tenant Admin on Growth and Enterprise tenants and verify that Dimension-Based Routing is absent or refused on Growth but available and usable on Enterprise.
Switching or provisioning tenants by plan, and observing or exercising the Dimension-Based Routing approval configuration, are not supported by the catalog.
